title: Mindfulness Seminar 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating mindfulness by simply paying attention to the present moment without trying to change or fix anything. This involves noticing physical sensations, breathing, and emotions without judgment, allowing participants to settle into the present and develop greater awareness of their bodies and experiences. By practicing mindfulness in a non-judgmental way, individuals can gain a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them, leading to greater clarity and insight in daily life.
